validity.recommendation: flag PipelineType for human review against the novosib-gov.ru decree's distribution classification; do not auto-change without a second corroborating source (GEM's transmission label may reflect a defensible convention of treating the named combined Omsk-Novosibirsk-Kuzbass system as one PipelineType) -- but the row's Diameter/Capacity figures should not be treated as independently sourced for this leg specifically until a segment-level source is found
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: genuine -- the Novosibirsk Oblast government gasification-programme decree (144-п, 30.03.2022, novosib-gov.ru/doc/101733) explicitly and separately lists 'Новосибирск – Кузбасс' as one of the region's распределительные газопроводы (distribution gas pipelines), distinct from the магистральный (transmission) 'Омск – Новосибирск' line in the same sentence -- this is a real, named pipeline in an official regulatory document, not a duplicate or fabricated row. CLASSIFICATION CONCERN: GEM records PipelineType=transmission for this leg, matching the parent combined system's branding ('Omsk-Novosibirsk-Kuzbass Gas Pipeline'), but the same government decree that confirms the pipeline's existence classifies it as distribution-grade, and Gazprom Transgaz Tomsk's own current system-overview page (tomsk-tr.gazprom.ru/about/today/) does not name 'Novosibirsk-Kuzbass' as one of its named top-level gas transport systems at all (only Omsk-Novosibirsk and three others appear) -- consistent with this leg being administratively a distribution/local-delivery line downstream of the Omsk-Novosibirsk trunk, not an independently ranked transmission system. Contrast with sibling P2458 (Yurga-Novosibirsk), which is ALSO named 'distribution' by this same decree but has a counter-source (an engineering thesis citing construction code SP 36.13330.2012 directly classifying that specific object as transmission-grade) -- no equivalent counter-source was found for THIS leg, so the concern stands unresolved here rather than being downgraded to a caveat. SPEC RED FLAG: this row's Diameter (1000, 1200, 1220 mm) and Capacity (14.00 bcm/y) are identical to P2362's (Omsk-Novosibirsk) figures -- this pass found the ONLY candidate source for those diameters (the Rostekhnadzor filing) actually documents a km-range (472-498 km) that belongs to the UPSTREAM Omsk-Novosibirsk leg, not this one (see this row's Diameter fill, UNRESOLVED); no source independently supports trunk-scale (1000-1220 mm) pipe on a 99 km distribution-classified leg. Combined with this row's Length (99.00 km) being a documented NF estimate ('similar to Yurga-Novosibirsk', per existing ResearcherNotes) rather than a sourced figure, the pattern across all three owed units (Length estimated-not-sourced, Diameter borrowed from a ref that actually belongs to a different segment, Operator only medium-tier-confirmed) is consistent with this row's spec values having been populated by copying the parent trunk's figures rather than independently sourced for this specific 99 km leg. NOT recommending an auto-change to PipelineType/Diameter/Capacity -- this is a single regulatory-document classification against GEM's existing (differently-sourced, presumably Gazprom-branding-derived) transmission label, and the AGGREGATE-VS-SEGMENT question needs a human call on whether GEM's combined-system convention should hold or whether this leg should be split out as distribution-grade with its own, smaller-diameter spec. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate of P2458 (Yurga-Novosibirsk) despite the length coincidence (99 km each) -- the same decree names both as separate, geographically distinct lines, and the Barabinsky-branch article independently describes Omsk-Novosibirsk-Kuzbass as one of five currently active Gazprom Transgaz Tomsk systems, implying Novosibirsk-Kuzbass is a real, distinct, currently-operating leg of it, not a phantom row. | contested (as authored): {"PipelineType": "distribution (распределительный) per novosib-gov.ru decree 144-п, vs. recorded transmission"}

Not recommending deletion of the ref from the sheet (this is a relevance finding, not a confirmed-dead-link finding, and the document is still useful for Operator on this row -- see that fill), but this row's Diameter (1000, 1200, 1220 mm, identical to P2362's three-value figure) has NO independent source of its own. Searched tomsk-tr.gazprom.ru/about/today/ (doesn't name this leg separately) and the novosib-gov.ru decree (classification only, no spec figures); found nothing pipe-diameter-specific to this leg.
